places.name: The Plaza Market
places.epithet: A permanent market for orcish goods
places.text: Brandmouth's plaza has a permanent market for orcish goods and a permanent watch for orcish trouble, and the two are often the same people on different days.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Watch-House
places.epithet: A permanent watch for orcish trouble
places.text: The tower on the plaza's edge from which the watch keeps an eye on the market, and on the sea beyond it.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Envoys' Hall
places.text: Where envoys from the Iron Hordes are received on landing and where the Union's own envoys wait for a ship south.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Soulstone Exchange
places.text: A small, very well-guarded house where the soulstone-traders who make the crossing worth daring meet their buyers.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Southern Mole
places.text: The long breakwater where ships that dare the crossing to the Iron Hordes load and unload.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Hiring Yard
places.text: Where mercenaries for the crossing, and for the caravans inland, wait to be hired, and practise on one another while they wait.

places.name: The Walls of Brandmouth
places.text: A walled port at the mouth of the Kingham.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The River Docks
places.text: Quays along the Kingham, where river-boats bring down what the coast villages catch and cure.

places.name: The Brand Road
places.text: North-west along the shore, round the end of the ridge at Redbank, and up the Newleighin valley to Fjerfi.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South
